title: Predict the initialization sequence
prompt:
Implement `static List<String> trace()` that returns the exact observable initialization order for `new Derived()` in this class family:
1. `class Base { Base() { t("Base ctor"); } }` where `t` records into the trace.
2. `class Derived extends Base { static String S = t("D static"); int x = t("D field"); Derived() { t("D ctor"); } }`
Rules: `t` appends to a shared list and returns its argument. `trace()` creates one `Derived` and returns the recorded list. Static init happens at first active use — instantiation counts.

tests.name: initialization order is exact
tests.code:
List<String> expected = List.of("D static", "Base ctor", "D field", "D ctor");
checkEq(Solution.trace(), expected, "trace matches JLS 12.4 order");
tests.hint: super() runs before subclass field initializers; static runs once at first use.

tests.name: second instance skips static
tests.hint: Class initialization happens once per class, not per instance.
